desc: 燕麦灰泥墙加陶土色缝线标签，浅木开框单椅的晨光阅读角

name: 燕麦陶土浅木框单人沙发椅款

shots.intent: 搜索位一眼点：燕麦版面正拍把单椅的开框扶手、散垫滚边与四足锥形腿一次看清，先立住单件识别度。
shots.textZone: 左上角一枚 1px 虚线缝线标签（#E8E3D9 底加 #BE7968 虚描边）内一行短文案「{callout_1}」，画面不出现其它文字

shots.intent: 俯视分屏放大「小户型塞一组大沙发后走路都要侧身」的真实顾虑，用单椅留出通道与采光带对冲。
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏 #3E4A3C 苔墨色带内一行主标「{selling_point_1}」，两格底角各一枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 首屏承接：真实阅读角把单椅放回可坐可读的采光位，用地毯落地灯给尺度，让买家认领这种生活方式。
shots.textZone: 左上墙面留白：主标「{selling_point_2}」一行，其下一行小字距英文 kicker，再下一枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 同墙同光同框对比靠窗摆位与墙角围合摆位，让买家按自家开间和采光自己判断放哪，解决摆位焦虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_3}」，两格底角各一枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 正侧 90 度近摄把这件单椅最强识别点——开口扶手走向、扶手与前腿交接与四腿外撇——做实，回答值不值。
shots.textZone: 上方留白带：小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下一枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」，1px 虚线引线指向扶手与前腿交接

shots.intent: 俯角微距把布面织纹、坐垫滚边缝线和垫子落在木座框上的关系看清，把材质与坐感疑虑落到可见证据。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带：小标题「{selling_point_5}」与其下两枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，1px 虚线引线指向滚边

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把四条方截面锥形腿、外撇角度与落地接触做实，证明整机比例与站立稳定不是贴图。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚虚线缝线标签「{callout_1}」，以 1px 虚线引线连到腿足落点

shots.intent: 把源页空色卡与百分比数字改成实际可选布色排布，让买家先解决选色这一犹豫，不被无意义数字干扰。
shots.textZone: 每枚色卡底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线，其上一行小字距英文 kicker 与一行主标「{selling_point_6}」

shots.intent: 用三枚缝线图标看点加一张通用参数表把「看什么、含什么」摊开，以透明结构替代源页的供应商 logo 与检测背书。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；三枚虚线方框图标各配一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」；下方四行通用参数表行名为产品名称／产品规格／面料／包装方式，数值一律为占位符「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位的暮色收口，把整页情绪落回可坐可读的阅读角，再给一个明确的咨询选色动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一燕麦版面留白：主标「{selling_point_2}」，其下一枚直角虚线描边按钮，填色 #BE7968，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real japandi reading corner with a mid-tone sage-grey plaster wall #A9B7A8 over a pale matte wide-plank floor #DCD4C7 with a visible skirting line, one undyed wool felt rug #D6CFC0 and one sheer curtain panel at a declared frame edge; a seamless oat-plaster studio sweep #E8E3D9 blending into a pale plank band #DCD4C7 for packshots, anatomy and spec screens; and one flat deep moss-ink field #3E4A3C carrying a single 1px dashed clay #BE7968 rule for trust and closing layouts. Photographs run full-bleed inside a hairline dashed outline on two edges only; every in-image label is drawn as a stitched tag, a #E8E3D9 fill closed by a 1px dashed #BE7968 outline; never a seal circle, never a corner bracket, never a solid disc, never a filled number chip, never a rounded card; one clean copy zone per screen and never busy decor
style.direction: japandi reading-corner commerce for a single-seat timber-frame lounge chair: an oat-plaster and sage-grey daylight room closed by clay-rose stitched-outline tags, deliberately NOT a warm ink-and-rice-paper vermilion editorial, NOT an airy cool north-daylight nordic room, NOT a mid-tone slate-and-charcoal graphic interior and NOT a cool celadon slat-shadow tea studio

style.lightingSystem: neutral-bright interior daylight grade at 4600-4800K: one low direct sun source entering from a declared off-frame window at camera LEFT at roughly 25 degrees elevation, so it lays one crisp-edged rectangular light patch on the floor and wall and throws the chair shadow long toward camera-right, plus a broad unspeculative sky bounce on the camera-right shadow side keeping the frame underside readable; matte timber rendered by grazing light so the figure reads as topography with no hot specular, one grounded contact shadow under all four feet, no floor mirror; this is deliberately NOT a warm 3000-3200K lace-raked key, NOT a diffuse cool 6500-7000K north-daylight wash, NOT a flat neutral 4000-4300K ceiling-downlight wash and NOT a high 5000-5200K camera-right slat-bar pattern

style.presentationRules: the chair keeps one proportional scale and one identity in every frame: a single open timber seat frame, the flat-topped squared arm rail and the way the front leg runs up into it, the wide timber apron rail below the seat, the four tapered square legs and their outward splay, exactly one loose seat cushion and one loose piped back cushion and their seam, the visible joint where rail, leg and apron meet, and the same timber tone #C7A377 against the same cloth tone #D9D5CC; no ottoman, footstool, headrest, spindle, slat back, tufting or metal part is ever added; it stands on the floor with true contact shadows under all four feet and never floats or tilts off its feet; interior verticals, wall corners, skirting and curtain lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (felt rug, floor lamp, side table, stacked books) always anchors human scale at true single-seat size; the slight 3/4 camera-left sun angle of the opening screens is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one corner
style.surfaceSystem: the frame renders as real timber exactly as supplied at #C7A377 with visible figure running along the rail length and a matte oiled surface, deepening to #8E7048 in the frame shade and #6B5433 under the apron; upholstery stays a matte woven cloth #D9D5CC finished with a contrasting bound edge #4C4842, never gloss, vinyl or leather; pale matte plank floor #DCD4C7, undyed wool felt rug #D6CFC0, sage linen drapery #9DAF9A, one clay-rose glazed stoneware vessel #BE7968, clear glass, one stacked paperback and a matte black-grey floor-lamp stem #4A4A46; graphic screens use flat oat-plaster and moss-ink fields with hairline dashed rules, no marble, no gloss laminate, no plastic sheen
style.typography: one medium-weight humanist sans family for Chinese display, set with generous tracking in #3E4A3C on oat fields and #E8E3D9 on moss fields, every display line closed inside one 1px dashed stitched-outline tag; small letter-spaced uppercase Latin kickers at 11pt in #BE7968; numerals and table values share the same humanist sans at regular weight; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-36pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters; never a high-contrast Ming or Song serif, never brush calligraphy, never a heavy bold grotesque, never a seal flourish over the first glyph
